description: This script sets up and runs a series of tests related to Git's 'skip-worktree' feature, involving operations like reading trees, updating index, cleaning, stashing, sparse checkout, and others, primarily for testing Git behavior under specific scenarios.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Removes the file '1' from the index, adds it again with specific cache info, and sets it to skip-worktree mode.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Marks the file '1' as dirty in the working directory, updates index, and sets it to skip-worktree mode.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Verifies the state of the file '1' in various index and working directory scenarios.
